categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: live-streaming e-commerce, e-commerce direct sales, and mineral products business including lithium mining and other mineral trading. It also has leasing and game operation businesses. The company is transitioning its focus from live-streaming e-commerce to e-commerce direct sales and expanding into the new energy sector, particularly lithium mining and battery materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages internet live-streaming and short video marketing technologies for its e-commerce business. In the lithium mining segment, it employs mining and beneficiation technologies for lithium extraction from spodumene deposits. The company also invests in new energy technologies related to lithium battery materials and green sulfuric acid production. It uses cost and revenue recognition methods aligned with industry standards for e-commerce and mining operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual consumers purchasing leisure snacks and food products via online platforms such as Kuaishou and Douyin, as well as industrial clients in lithium battery manufacturing and mineral trading sectors. The company serves domestic markets predominantly, with minor international sales. The new energy segment targets the rapidly growing electric vehicle and energy storage markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and major operations in Guangxi and Shenzhen. Lithium mining assets are located in Sanmenxia, Henan Province. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and other Chinese cities. The company’s e-commerce activities cover major Chinese online platforms, and its mineral products are sold domestically with limited international exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and downstream in the supply chain. Upstream, it controls lithium mining and beneficiation operations. Midstream and downstream, it engages in e-commerce direct sales and live-streaming marketing of consumer products, as well as mineral product trading. It also acts as a service provider in live-streaming e-commerce, coordinating brand resources and marketing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is shifting from live-streaming e-commerce to strengthening its e-commerce direct sales with a focus on self-owned food brands and multi-channel distribution. It is investing in lithium mining infrastructure and new energy projects, including a green sulfuric acid production facility. R&D efforts focus on product innovation in snacks and new energy technologies, while enhancing digital marketing and live-streaming service capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales in e-commerce direct sales and live-streaming commission fees. The company also earns rental income from leasing operations and sales from mineral products including lithium ore. Investment income and financial asset trading contribute to non-operating revenue. Revenue recognition follows delivery and payment confirmation on e-commerce platforms and contract fulfillment in mining and trading.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the mature live-streaming e-commerce market with many players and platforms developing their own influencer ecosystems. In lithium mining and new energy, it competes with domestic and international mining companies. The company positions itself as a dual-focus enterprise combining e-commerce and new energy sectors, leveraging its mining assets and e-commerce platform partnerships to build competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 161 million, a 35.53% decline from 2023, mainly due to strategic restructuring and reduced live-streaming business. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 316 million, reflecting asset impairments and credit losses. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 1.07 billion, down 34.12% year-over-year. It is in a critical growth and transformation phase, investing heavily in new energy and e-commerce direct sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated live-streaming services combining people, products, and venues to enhance marketing efficiency. It differentiates through multi-brand, multi-channel strategies in self-owned food products and deep integration of lithium mining resources with new energy development. Its dual business model aims to provide stable growth by balancing traditional e-commerce with strategic new energy investments, supported by strong government and local partnerships.
